llm.summary: This is a coherent local note-taking skill that asks for confirmation before writing learning records, with no scripts, hooks, network access, or cross-session behavior in the artifacts.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to capture lessons, errors, best practices, reviews, and improvement suggestions; the runtime instructions match that purpose and limit storage to project-local `.learnings/` files.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Some trigger phrases are broad natural-language phrases, but the skill repeatedly requires preview and user confirmation before writes, and the behavior remains aligned with its note-taking purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only Markdown documentation plus license/changelog files; static scan reports no findings and no executable scripts are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Artifact frontmatter requests no environment variables or binaries. Platform metadata includes a sensitive-credentials capability tag, but the artifact itself does not request or use credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistence is disclosed and scoped to `.learnings/LEARNINGS.md`, `.learnings/ERRORS.md`, and `.learnings/IMPROVEMENTS.md`; destructive behavior is limited to clearing that directory with double confirmation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this skill can summarize parts of the current conversation into local project notes after you confirm. Use it when you are comfortable storing sanitized lessons in `.learnings/`, and decline confirmation if a draft includes sensitive or unnecessary details.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The README trigger phrases are broad enough to merit user awareness, but they map directly to the skill's disclosed recording/review functions and are bounded by confirmation before file writes.
[SQP-1] expected: The SKILL.md trigger phrases such as short Chinese conversational commands could cause accidental drafting, but artifact evidence does not show silent persistence, exfiltration, hooks, or behavior outside `.learnings/`.
